ei.title: 4번: Petra: The Lost City in the Desert
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: The ancient city of Petra, located deep in the desert of Jordan, was established around the year 300 B.C. by a nomadic tribe called the Nabataeans. The Nabataeans used their superior architectural skills to carve the city's palaces, temples, and houses directly into sandstone cliffs. They also built a system of waterways to supply the city with water. Because Petra was located at the crossroads of ancient trading routes, it became a major place of commerce. The great wealth brought in by trade allowed the city to prosper. After many years, though, changing trade routes and a huge earthquake led inhabitants to abandon this remarkable city. Petra had been forgotten for centuries when it was rediscovered by a Swiss explorer in 1812. Since then, the archaeological site of the city has been extensively excavated, and it is now a popular tourist destination.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① established — superior — prosper: 원문 일치. 도시가 설립되었고(established), 뛰어난(superior) 건축 기술, 무역으로 번영했다(prosper)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② dismantled — superior — prosper: (A) dismantled(해체된)는 established(설립된)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ established — inferior — prosper: (B) inferior(열등한)는 superior(뛰어난)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ established — superior — decline: (C) decline(쇠퇴하다)는 prosper(번영하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: was established(설립되었다) / superior architectural skills(뛰어난 건축 기술) / allowed the city to prosper(도시가 번영하게 했다)

❌ ④ classical: classical(고전적인)은 ancient와 유사한 의미
det.tip: ancient(고대의) ↔ modern(현대의) — 시대의 대조

questions.passage: After years of training, Maria decided to learn a new <u>trade</u> and became a skilled carpenter. She opened her own workshop and built furniture for local families. Because Petra was located at the crossroads of ancient trading routes, it became a major place of commerce. The great wealth brought in by <u>trade</u> allowed the city to prosper.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 trade의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 직업/기술 — (B) 무역/교역: (A)는 목수라는 숙련된 직업(기술)을 배웠다는 맥락, (B)는 교역이 가져온 부로 도시가 번영했다는 상업 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 거래 — (B) 직업: (A)의 trade는 거래가 아닌 직업, (B)는 직업이 아닌 무역
❌ ③ (A) 직업/기술 — (B) 교환: (B)의 trade는 단순 교환이 아닌 무역/상업 활동
❌ ④ (A) 교역 — (B) 무역/교역: (A)의 trade는 교역이 아닌 직업/기술
det.tip: trade: ① 직업/기술 (a skilled trade) ② 무역/교역 (international trade)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to cut or shape a hard material such as stone or wood into a desired form"

det.analysis:
❌ ① demolish: demolish(파괴하다)는 형태를 만드는 것이 아닌 부수는 것
❌ ② excavate: excavate(발굴하다)는 땅에서 파내는 것으로 조각과 다름
✅ ③ carve: carve(조각하다)는 돌이나 나무 등을 원하는 형태로 깎는 것으로 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ construct: construct(건설하다)는 재료를 쌓아 만드는 것으로 깎아 만드는 것과 다름
det.tip: carve = 돌/나무 등 단단한 재료를 깎아서 형태를 만들다

questions.passage: Because Petra was located at the crossroads of ancient __________ (trade) routes, it became a major place of commerce.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: ancient __________ (trade) routes — routes(명사)를 수식하는 형용사 자리. trade의 현재분사형 trading이 형용사로 사용되어 '교역의/무역의' 의미. trading routes = 교역로
det.tip: trading routes = 교역로. trade(명사/동사) → trading(형용사적 현재분사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: The city was __________ (supply) with water — 수동태 구조이므로 과거분사형 supplied가 필요. 도시에 물이 공급되었다(was supplied)는 수동 의미

questions.passage: The ancient city of Petra, located deep in the desert of Jordan, was established around the year 300 B.C. by a nomadic tribe called the Nabataeans. The Nabataeans used their superior architectural skills to carve the city's palaces, temples, and houses directly into sandstone cliffs. They also built a system of waterways to supply the city with water. Because Petra was located __________, it became a major place of commerce. The great wealth brought in by trade allowed the city to prosper. After many years, though, changing trade routes and a huge earthquake led inhabitants to abandon this remarkable city. Petra had been forgotten for centuries when it was rediscovered by a Swiss explorer in 1812. det.analysis:
❌ ① deep in the desert of Jordan: 사막 깊은 곳이라는 위치 설명은 상업 중심지가 된 원인이 아님
✅ ② at the crossroads of ancient trading routes: 원문 일치. 교역로 교차점에 위치했기 때문에 상업의 주요 장소가 되었다는 인과 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ by a Swiss explorer in 1812: 재발견 시점의 정보로 상업 중심지 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ into sandstone cliffs: 사암 절벽은 건축 방식의 설명으로 상업 맥락과 무관
det.tip: Because Petra was located at the crossroads of ancient trading routes, it became a major place of commerce — 위치가 상업 발전의 원인
